07/20/2024
The claimant reported a low-speed rear-end contact in a parking lot and described neck pain beginning shortly
afterward. The claim was opened and the file assigned for review.
08/30/2024
The driver is named on the policy, and the policy was active on the reported loss date. Coverage appears to apply to
this incident.
09/01/2024
Photos submitted by the claimant show damage to the rear bumper that is consistent with the impact described. No
independent witnesses have come forward so far.
09/07/2024
Police records confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. The responding officer's notes match the basic
sequence the claimant gave.
10/25/2024
The claimant's account was the same in each conversation, including the location, the direction of travel, and the
sequence of events. Nothing in the conversations raised a concern.
11/29/2024
The reported whiplash injury is plausible for a collision of this type. The claimant has been treated by a provider and
the records were requested.
02/03/2025
Medical records show no prior injury to the neck or upper back. Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is
typical for this injury, so the treating notes are being reviewed.
02/07/2025
The repair estimate was checked against the damage in the photos and the vehicle's prior history. No earlier damage
to the vehicle is on file, and the repair scope matches the described impact.
02/21/2025
The file is ready for the next review step. The extended treatment period will be discussed with the medical reviewer
before any settlement decision is made.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
